competitiveTarget: Beat Zillow / Redfin / Windermere regional market entry pages. KB chrome (KbNav/KbHero/KbExploreTowns), live per-city active-count tiles, broker sell CTA, and the KB footer no aggregator carries.
note: Hub page at /housing-market. Converted to KB design system (Phase 9). Region glance lede from getMarketPulse. Per-city tiles from ONE getMarketPulseCitySnapshots call linking to /housing-market/<slug>. No Dataset/FAQPage JSON-LD (those belong to /housing-market/central-oregon so the two URLs never duplicate structured market data). Shares the market-report/index.html mockup; a dedicated hub mockup is a follow-up deliverable.

requiredComponents.name: MetadataBlock
requiredComponents.section: BreadcrumbList + WebPage JSON-LD only. No Dataset; that lives on /housing-market/central-oregon.

requiredComponents.name: KbNav
requiredComponents.section: KB chrome nav — universal across all KB pages.

requiredComponents.name: KbSectionTracker
requiredComponents.section: Page-level analytics tracker, pageType='market-report'. Required by the KB page contract.

requiredComponents.name: SmoothScrollProvider
requiredComponents.section: Smooth-scroll wrapper for all KB sections below the breadcrumb.

requiredComponents.name: KbHero
requiredComponents.section: Region eyebrow + data-driven glance lede from getMarketPulse (activeCount, medianListPrice, medianDaysToPending). eyebrow 'Central Oregon · Oregon', titleTop 'Central Oregon', titleBottom 'housing market'.

requiredComponents.name: KbExploreTowns
requiredComponents.section: Per-city navigation tiles with live active counts from getMarketPulseCitySnapshots. Each tile links to /housing-market/<city-slug>. eyebrow 'Central Oregon', title 'Market by city'. The hub's primary navigation function.

requiredComponents.name: KbArticles
requiredComponents.section: Recent published blog posts (getRecentBlogPosts, limit 3). Provides cross-links to guides and region insights. Renders null when no posts available.

requiredComponents.name: ContentSection
requiredComponents.section: Curated resource cross-links (region report, reports index, open data explorer, all cities, communities, homes-for-sale, guides, area guides). Restored from the pre-KB hub: the KB chrome does not otherwise surface these sibling routes from this page, so dropping them lost internal-linking / SEO value.

requiredComponents.name: KbSell
requiredComponents.section: Seller conversion CTA, eyebrow 'Sell in Central Oregon'. Data from regionPulse (medianListPrice, medianDaysToPending, closedLast30Days).

requiredComponents.name: LeadCaptureBlock
requiredComponents.section: General 'ask a broker' inquiry form (variant='inquiry'), submitted through submitMarketPageInquiry → submitPageCTA (FUB person + event, Meta CAPI, canonical tagging, GA4 mirror). Restored from the pre-KB hub: KbSell only routes to the seller valuation flow, so without this a buyer/general market question had no on-page lead-capture surface.

requiredComponents.name: KbFooter
requiredComponents.section: Full sitemap close with city towns array for footer links.

layoutComponents.name: SiteHeader
layoutComponents.note: Not in requiredComponents because the gate checks the route file.

layoutComponents.name: SiteFooter
layoutComponents.note: Not in requiredComponents because the gate checks the route file.

deferredComponents.name: KbMarketHud
deferredComponents.reason: Hub is a nav/overview page. The full market HUD (KbMarketHud with price chart + yearSeries) belongs to the /housing-market/central-oregon region report, which already has it. Adding it here would duplicate a heavy data fetch and compete with the region report page.

deferredComponents.name: FAQBlock
deferredComponents.reason: Region FAQ + FAQPage JSON-LD live on /housing-market/central-oregon (the AI-citable report). The hub omits them to keep the two URLs focused on different user intents.

deferredComponents.name: KbCommunities
deferredComponents.reason: Community tiles appropriate at the city level (cities/[slug]). Hub uses KbExploreTowns for city-level navigation.

jsonLd.note: Hub is a nav/overview page. The region Dataset + FAQPage are emitted by /housing-market/central-oregon (market-report-region) so the two URLs do not duplicate the same structured market data.

dataLayer.getMarketPulse: lib/data/market/getMarketPulse.ts, market_pulse_live geo_type='region' geo_slug='central-oregon' property_type='A', 10 to 15 min freshness. Used for KbHero lede and KbSell data.
dataLayer.getMarketPulseCitySnapshots: lib/data/market/getMarketPulseSnapshot.ts, market_pulse_live city rows geo_label IN CITY_LABELS, ONE call. Used by KbExploreTowns active counts.
dataLayer.getRecentBlogPosts: lib/data/blog/getRecentBlogPosts.ts, blog_posts status='published', newest first, limit 3. Used by KbArticles.
dataLayer.submitMarketPageInquiry: app/housing-market/actions.ts (route-local server action) → submitPageCTA. Bound to the restored LeadCaptureBlock inquiry form. Same action the /housing-market/[...slug] flagship page uses.
dataLayer.note: All read DAL functions imported from @/lib/data (G8 compliant). The only non-DAL import is the route-local server action submitMarketPageInquiry for the lead form (same pattern as the [...slug] page); it routes writes through submitPageCTA, not a raw .from().
